item.title: Trial set for Las Vegas man accused of killing boy, storing body in freezer
item.description: The trial for the Las Vegas man accused of killing his girlfriend’s son and storing his body in a freezer will happen in more than a year, a judge said Tuesday.

item.title: Wynn Resorts target of cybersecurity breach
item.description: Las Vegas hotel and casino operator Wynn Resorts appears to be the latest victim of a cybersecurity incident, according to a federal lawsuit.

item.title: Clark County judge denies attempt by Henderson councilwoman to avoid felony prosecution
item.description: A Clark County District Court judge denied an attempt by a Henderson councilwoman to avoid felony prosecution after a grand jury indictment.

item.title: Trump seeks to calm economic jitters in longest-ever State of the Union
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — President Donald Trump declared during Tuesday's marathon State of the Union that “we’re winning so much,” saying he'd sparked a jobs and manufacturing boom at home while imposing a new world order abroad — hoping that offering a long list of his accomplishments can counter approval ratings that have been falling. item.title: Looming insurance rate hikes cloud Nevada employees' morale; 'mass exodus' coming?
item.description: State employees and retirees warned there would be a mass exodus if insurance rates go up as much as projected, calling for an audit of the Public Employees' Benefits Program (PEBP) and demanding alternatives.

item.title: NV Energy to issue more than $63M in refunds to customers who overpaid
item.description: NV Energy announced Tuesday it would be issuing more than $63 million as part of refunds to customers who were overcharged because of account misclassifications.

item.title: Las Vegas HOA considers bulletproof glass for meetings
item.description: A Las Vegas homeowners association considered purchasing bulletproof glass for their meetings, but some neighbors say a more pressing concern lies with where their money is going.

item.title: Nevada officials react to President Trump's 2026 State of the Union address
item.description: Nevada lawmakers and officials reacted to President Donald Trump's 2026 State of the Union address Tuesday, commenting on how the first year of his second term has affected Nevadans.

item.title: Las Vegas man listed in Nevada 'Black Book' allegedly tried to lure 13-year-old into car
item.description: A Las Vegas man added to Nevada’s “Black Book” in 2022 allegedly tried to lure a 13-year-old girl into his vehicle, according to an arrest report.

item.title: Las Vegas man killed ex-girlfriend, set home on fire because he 'got tired of her': police
item.description: The man accused of shooting and killing his ex-girlfriend and setting a home on fire told Las Vegas police he did it because he "got tired of her," according to documents 8 News Now obtained Tuesday.
